purpose: Prove the Y-Shopping Merchant deposit thresholds with exact minor-unit conservation, controlled enforcement, causal Merchant suspension, and durable physical Listing unpublish.
prerequisite: A SUCCEEDED canonical-merchant-sales-eligibility-v1 ledger that leaves the controlled Merchant ACTIVE and Listing PUBLISHED.
money_contract: All amounts are signed 64-bit integer minor units plus ISO-4217 currency; this scenario uses CNY.
writes: deduct to 55 percent BID_RESTRICTED without Merchant suspension
deduct to 19 percent SALES_BLOCKED with causal Merchant suspension and Listing unpublish
top up without automatic Merchant resume or Listing republish
explicitly resume Merchant and explicitly republish Listing after review
invariants: coverage at or above 60 percent is SUFFICIENT, 20 to below 60 percent is BID_RESTRICTED, and below 20 percent is SALES_BLOCKED
only an ENFORCED account crossing into SALES_BLOCKED can suspend an ACTIVE Merchant
the deposit ledger event is the causation of exactly one Merchant SUSPENDED event and one Listing unpublish Saga
top-up never automatically resumes Merchant and resume never automatically republishes Listing
all eight deposit writes, one Merchant resume, and one Listing publish replay as immutable duplicates
forbidden_shortcuts: raw bank, identity, phone, or voucher data in events or ledgers
automatic Merchant resume or Listing republish
cleanup: No destructive cleanup. The account remains ENFORCED and SUFFICIENT; Merchant and Listing are restored only through explicit reviewed commands, while ledger, Saga, Outbox, and lakehouse evidence remain immutable.
